notes: Calvary Chapel-style church on La Canada Dr. ADDRESS CORRECTED: the church's own site prints the address as '6901 N La Canada Dr, Tucson, AZ 85704' (it uses the spelling 'La Canada' with a tilde), not Oro Valley, so the city is recorded as Tucson and the previous hand-entered coordinates were dropped - run tools/geocode.py. Services Sun 9 & 11 AM, Wed 7 PM. THREE PREACHERS, NOT ONE: the leadership page lists Craig Roters (Founding & Senior Pastor), Morgan Roters (Associate & Worship Pastor) and Kevin McPhail (Assistant Pastor); the earlier note guessing that Morgan Roters was only a spouse/ministry partner was wrong. The YouTube playlist list settles it - there are parallel book studies labelled '(Pastor Craig)' and '(Pastor Morgan)' plus a 'Pastor Kevin' playlist, so per-sermon attribution is essential. Moriah Reilly is Church Office Administrator & Assistant Youth Leader and is not recorded as a preacher. YouTube channel found: @CalvaryOroValley (channel id UCRfDUkO9loMVfv3lKGb8Pdw). Sermon playlists were not listed individually in this record because the channel uses dozens of per-book playlists; browse /playlists and pick the ones matching the pastor under review. Caption availability not tested. Also on Facebook (calvaryorovalley7) and Instagram.
